info.title: Amrutam Telemedicine API
info.description: All mutations require a unique Idempotency-Key (16–128 alphanumeric, underscore or hyphen). Reuse the same key and payload after an ambiguous failure. All users require TOTP MFA.

post.summary: Register patient and obtain MFA enrollment token
Validate password and obtain MFA challenge
Create TOTP secret; limited to initial enrollment
Verify one-time TOTP and issue 15 minute access token

patch.summary: Set user role or suspend account and revoke sessions

post.summary: Verify and publish a doctor directory entry

get.summary: Filter verified doctors using stable UUID cursor

post.summary: Publish a nonoverlapping doctor availability slot
Atomically book slot, record payment intent and queue analytics

get.summary: Read own consultation and prescriptions with audit

patch.summary: Transition booked → in_progress → completed, or cancel booked

post.summary: Issue immutable prescription as assigned doctor

get.summary: Read asynchronous daily aggregates with freshness timestamp
Read bounded audit metadata (no clinical payload)
